statements.text:
Big news coming from @INL, as it is one of the four sites selected for AI infrastructure and generation projects!

Thank you, @SecretaryWright and @POTUS, for your leadership in promoting American leadership in AI. INL will continue to play a critical role in the global AI race.
statements.quoted:
📣 NOW LEASING: @ENERGY is seeking proposals to build and power AI data centers at @INL to cement U.S. leadership in AI and help scale up emerging power sources like advanced reactors.

statements.text: States like Idaho are looking at ways to regulate data centers and prevent them from raising energy costs for American families. I've heard from several Idahoans regarding the data center issue, particularly their concerns about rising costs. Addressing these community concerns and establishing proper guardrails is a step in the right direction to ensure state and local control over data centers and protect American communities from increased costs.
